description: The finale quest is triggered only by its own completion (quest-complete of itself), so it can never become active and never completes. No static rule is violated — depends_on is acyclic and empty (DW0130), the plan converges (DW0132), the trigger reference resolves (DW0112), and the keeper's talk-to objective still has a reachable completing option (DW0123). Only the compiler's deep fixpoint sees the deadlock: exit 2 / DW0201 (plus DW0202). Proves analyze is not vacuous now that the dialogue-completion case is caught statically.
